theme.description: Premium modern interface inspired by Stripe, Vercel, Linear. Focus on progressive disclosure and functional clarity.
theme.support: Light and Dark mode toggle required in Top Nav. Defaults to light.

colors.primary: Emerald Green (#10B981) - Used for primary actions and key positive metrics.
colors.secondary: Gold Accents (#D4AF37) - Used for premium features, pending states, or special highlights.
colors.neutral_light: White background, off-white surface (#FAFAFA), slate-50 to slate-200 for borders.
colors.neutral_dark: Charcoal Black (#121212) for text, (#1A1A1A) for dark mode backgrounds.
colors.rules: Color is Function Only. 95% of the UI should be monochrome. Color exists only to guide action. No full-screen gradients.

typography.headings: Manrope (Anti-default alternative to Inter). Use tight tracking (`tracking-tight`) for H1-H2.
typography.hierarchy_rules: H1 max text-4xl on desktop, H2 text-2xl. Overlines must be uppercase + tiny + wide spacing. No Inter, Roboto, or Open Sans.

surfaces_and_micro_themes.dashboard_cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (`border-border`), no shadow by default. On hover: `-translate-y-1` and `shadow-md`.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.navigation: Clean Sidebar Navigation + Top Navigation. Solid background for Top Nav, no transparent glass over scrolling content.
surfaces_and_micro_themes.modals_and_overlays: Glassmorphism with heavy blur (`backdrop-blur-xl`) and `bg-black/60` (dark) or `bg-white/70` (light).

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous Spacing. Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders must have padding (`p-6` or `p-8`).
layout_and_grids.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (Bento Protocol B). Tight gaps (`gap-4` or `gap-6`). Summary stats: `col-span-1`. Main chart: `col-span-2 row-span-2`.
layout_and_grids.alignment: Left-align dense content. Top-left focus for North Star metric (Progressive disclosure pattern).

components_and_interactions.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded (`rounded-lg`) with interaction animations (hover states).
components_and_interactions.tables: Lead Management data table: search, filter, status badges, row actions, CSV export. Left-aligned tabular data.
components_and_interactions.forms: CMS editor needs section-based forms with visibility toggles. Use Shadcn components heavily customized (no standard Vercel look).
components_and_interactions.motion: Micro-animations for hover, click, focus. Entrance animations staggered for lists. Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.

image_urls.description: Images for CMS preview and placeholder pages. NEVER use generic dummy image placeholders.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react (default) or @phosphor-icons/react for premium duotone aesthetic. Command: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`.
icons_and_assets.rules: No AI assistant emojis for icons.

accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for text below 18px. Always explicitly set text color on hover. Use APCA contrast calculator over WCAG 2.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-form-submit-button"`).

instructions_to_main_agent: Use .js/.jsx extensions instead of .tsx for your files.
You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid 'AI slop' aesthetic.
DO NOT apply universal transition (`transition: all`).
DO NOT center align the app container (`.App { text-align: center; }`).
DO NOT use pure transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.
Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize the spacing, border radius, and shadows to match the AMASS brand.
Implement light and dark themes using Tailwind's `dark:` classes.
Create the placeholder pages (Properties, Agents, Users, etc.) as empty states with clear calls-to-action.
Implement the CMS Editor as a section-based form with visibility toggles and a live-preview feel using split panes or a prominent preview button.
general_ui_ux_guidelines: Prioritize progressive disclosure: surface the health/status signal first, then let users drill down.
Ensure top-left quadrant focuses on the primary North Star metric.
Keep standard F-pattern reading flow. Sidebar left, Top Nav, Content Area.
Pair charts with 'next best action' or task widgets.
Use empty states effectively to guide users on what to do next.
